# Medical Intern
1. Your direct superior is the Chief Medical Officer, but you are expected to follow the orders of your designated trainer.
2. Medical Interns are not permitted to utilize chemicals on their own without supervision.
3. Medical Interns are to work alongside a Medical Doctor or the Chief Medical Officer to complete medical training, unless instructed otherwise.
4. In emergencies, Medical Interns may treat patients as a Medical Doctor.
